headline: Lemmings learned to swim — and drown
lede: The shelf's never-dry pick got the original's most famous hazard: a pond at THE SPIRE's foot. Anything that touches water dies now — walkers wade in and sink, a twenty-tile drop into the pond ends in a splash, not a landing. Failed climbers can no longer pace the map for free.

notes.text: WATER terrain + drown rule in the Lemmings sim: chest or feet in water kills from any height; digging stops at the surface and bombs leave ponds standing, dirt stays the only destructible.

lemcheck grew 14 water pins (walk-in, any-height, dig/blast refusal, determinism over the new board) to 129/129; real-Chrome lemplay 40/40 watched an unmanaged crowd drown 8/8 through the FF button, blue pixels 0.97 where the grid says water.
The title finally has a README — engine notes plus four honest gaps (blocker-wake, 3-tile falls, the OH-NO! cry, static water) so the idle board can score it honestly from now on.
The warden's '-1 weak' signal came from another issue's body text naming Lemmings in a HUD-convention line — phantom weakness lives on; this time the pick still had real depth behind it.

look.text: THE SPIRE's new pond: dawdle on the west bank and the stragglers pay
